text: technology distinct error modes motivate different default thresholds: Illumina (minFreq = 0.03, minDepth = 100) Illumina short reads low per-base error rates (~0.1–0.5%)     systematic context-dependent errors. 3% frequency     threshold safely exceeds noise floor retaining true     low-frequency variants. Grubaugh et al. (2019) measured iSNVs     3% accurately least 1,000 RNA copies sequenced     least 400x, 100x permissive floor; low-frequency     false positives inflate diversity estimates markedly (McCrone &     Lauring 2016). Oxford Nanopore (ONT) (minFreq = 0.10,     minDepth = 60, maxStrandBias = Inf) ONT reads higher per-base error rates (~1–5% R10     chemistry), requiring conservative frequency threshold     10% avoid false positives; Bull et al. (2020) found     ONT sequencing accurately detect variants low     read-count frequencies, reported 99% sensitivity     precision single-nucleotide variants 60-fold     depth, sets depth threshold. Strand bias filtering     disabled (Inf) rather given untested threshold;     supply maxStrandBias explicitly data support one. PacBio HiFi (minFreq = 0.05, minDepth = 50) HiFi consensus reads reach 99.8% read accuracy via     circular consensus sequencing (Wenger et al. 2019), allowing     frequency threshold ONT Illumina. Depth 50x     reflects lower throughput high per-read accuracy. Generic Falls back standard ISNVFilter defaults     (minFreq = 0.03, minDepth = 100), suitable Illumina     technology unknown.

title: Chao1 richness estimator for iSNV data — chao1ISNV
text: Estimates total species (variant) richness using Chao1 estimator (Chao 1984): $$\hat{S}_{Chao1} = S_{obs} + \frac{f_1^2}{2 f_2}$$ \(S_{obs}\) observed number variants, \(f_1\) number singletons (variants altCount == 1), \(f_2\) number doubletons (variants altCount == 2). \(f_2 = 0\), bias-corrected form used: \(S_{obs} + f_1 (f_1 - 1) / 2\).

text: WithinHostExperiment S4 class extending RangedSummarizedExperiment within-host pathogen iSNV data, setValidity enforcing structural invariants. Multi-caller import: readWithinHost() reads VCFs LoFreq, Freebayes, generic iVar-style field layouts auto-detection (ivar variants writes TSV, iVar-style VCF comes converter). readWithinHostTable() handles iVar TSV directly, generic CSV. Replicate-aware QC: flagISNV() applies configurable quality filters without removing data. flagReplicateDiscordance() identifies discordant technical replicates full provenance logging. flagPrimerSites() masks amplicon primer regions. Diversity indices: shannonISNV(), piISNV() (optional finite-sample correction per Nei 1987), wattersonISNV(), simpsonISNV(), chao1ISNV(), calcDiversity() per-sample within-host diversity. Neutrality tests: tajimaD(), fusFs(), calcNeutralityTests() site-frequency-spectrum-based neutrality testing deep-sequencing-aware sample size capping. Site frequency spectrum first-class object: WithinHostSFS S4 class stores within-host SFS metadata (sample, genome length, depth, detection threshold). buildSFS() / buildSFSList() construct WHE; correctSFSBias() applies ascertainment bias correction detection threshold (truncation binomial method); neutralityFromSFS() computes Tajima’s D, Fu’s Fs, Fay Wu’s H (new) single SFS object; compareSFS() tests SFS homogeneity samples; plotSFS() provides publication-quality SFS visualisation. Temporal QC longitudinal data: flagTemporalInconsistency() identifies transient iSNVs appear one timepoint (likely artefacts) versus persistent ones detected across multiple consecutive timepoints. Supports configurable minTimepoints minConsecutive thresholds. Cross-contamination detection: detectCrossContamination() identifies index-hopping signatures high-frequency variant one sample appears suspiciously low frequency co-sequenced sample, consistent adapter exchange pooled sequencing. Returns structured DataFrame suspect events source/sink frequencies run metadata. GFF3 annotation: annotateFromGFF() overlaps variant sites gene models GFF3 file, adding GFF_FEATURE mcols(rowRanges) use dndsWithinHost(). annotateCodonChange() extends CDS-aware codon translation: given GFF3 reference FASTA, determines affected codon, translates reference alternative alleles using standard genetic code, classifies SNV Synonymous, Nonsynonymous, Nonsense. Multi-caller consensus: consensusISNV() deriving consensus variant calls across callers, calcCallerConcordance() inter-caller agreement metrics, benchmarkCallers() caller performance comparison. Longitudinal analysis: trackFrequency() tracking variant allele frequencies time, detectEmergingVariants() identifying newly arising variants, plotFrequencyTrajectory() publication-quality trajectory plots. Transmission analysis: transmissionPairs(), exportPairFrequencies(), calcSharedVariants(), quickBottleneck() (approximate beta-binomial MLE, Sobel Leonard et al. 2017) bottleneck estimation.
